title: Student agreement response
description: One student's response to one claim in a report. Records are appended, never edited; the latest responded_at for a claim is the current view. Nothing consumes these in Gate 0.
$comment: [OURS: deliberately unlike Sandpiper's markedAs/votingReason fields, which have no id, no timestamp, and are addressed by array position. This record has its own id and timestamp and addresses a claim by its stable claim_id. Reviewer identity and agreement measurement belong to Gate 3. See docs/DEVIATIONS.md D-013.]

responder.$comment: [OURS: the brief asks for the student's view. Accepting a parent's response would be a separate decision.]
